title: Wide cross-platform discovery pass 49
summary: Personally inspect 36 roots: 35 additions and one deferred wrapper.
notes: Root personally performed 36 broad searches, yielding 403 hits and 401 distinct repository roots, followed by pinned source inspection of 36 selected roots. Prepared 35 additions and one deferred binary-wrapper lead. No discovery worker was used. Baseline c06ffb3975caad0958476b594d11226b0a2475b2 contains 4283 projects and includes canonical BAKED EMULATION migration. Ingestion findings: format support must be tracked per operation; inherited README claims must be separated from current port status; a hand-named function map can still disclose agent naming in its research log; an anti-LLM source policy can allow AI in tools, so does not justify whole-project No; AI integration alone does not establish authorship. Empty example files and large vendored build trees are not completion evidence. Extensionless C and VB6 forms need source-aware discovery. Isolated Paula synthesis and general-purpose diagnostic emulators do not alone imply baked game execution. A build script invoking binary-only converters differs from preserved application source. Source review found limitations in old host APIs, header management, pointer/layout semantics and preview behavior. No upstream code was built or run, no private media retrieved, and no original binaries copied into the submission. Source pins are review snapshots, not guarantees that upstream remains unchanged.

sources.reason: Borland overlay analysis and recovered save formats support a semantic C++ economy remake. Inspected food rules retain original segment references and explicit unresolved arithmetic/banking checks, rather than pretending every rule is finished.
Source-preserving pointer/script translation pipeline, with explicit rendering-layout controls and fail-closed unknown modes. Currently one Alshark profile, not a general PC-88/PC-98 translator.

Electron workspace integrates Z80 decoding, memory/graphics analysis, watchpoints and automation. Inspected decoder bounds repeated prefixes and resolves indexed displacements. AI analysis capability is not evidence of AI authorship.
Annotated banked source and symbolic cutscene/nametable routines, with mostly Russian comments. Separate translation-focused repository, not merely a ROM upload.
Converts YM register recordings into SN76489 VGM with envelope, attenuation and noise adaptation. Target chip clocks/LFSR are configurable; not a CPU transcoder.
Vagrant provisioning for MiNT GCC, EmuTOS and Hatari, with sample C utilities. Supporting development environment, not recovered compiler source.
Browser disk browser plus boot-sector signatures, heuristics and bounded 68000 analysis. Source distinguishes executable checksum, legitimate protectors and infection indicators.

ACSI/serial interface experiments and native ST test programs. Inspected ACSIPACK assembly accesses DMA and GPIP; an ESP32 sample and ST C file are empty, so directory count is not implementation completeness.
E+ new-map/Filecore structures, fragment allocation, BigDir parsing and boot-loader preservation utilities. Current primary use is RISC OS Pi media, not every historical ADFS variant.
RISC OS 3 ROM checksum/size repair, striping and 5th-column extraction/building. Inspected checksum code implements four interleaved CRC accumulators.
ADFS, ArcFS, Spark, ZIP, ISO and sprite conversion preserving RISC OS metadata. Inspected ArcFS reader documents record layout and compression methods.
Line-at-a-time multi-backend assembler and CLI. Inspected 68000 backend handles BASIC token collisions and effective-address parsing. Host integration is distinct from output CPU support.
Small C resource-fork library with AppleSingle/AppleDouble discovery, big-endian headers and map-header verification. Evidence supports these primitives, not comprehensive resource-type decoding.
Parses resource forks using TMPL definitions, adding fork-local custom definitions without globally replacing built-ins. Source implements asynchronous template loading.
LZSA2 plus BCJ compression for on-demand DOS code overlays. Inspected loader allocates paragraphs, decompresses into a far segment and reverses branch transformation.
LZEXE 0.90/0.91/0.91e unpacker reconstructs MZ headers and relocation tables. Source returns a copied input for uncompressed data, so zero-copy wording must not be read as actual output behavior.
Game Boy loader and architecture plugin. Source validates logo/header and maps the first two ROM banks; do not infer full bank-switch analysis from loader support.
Annotated banked assembly with explicit uncertainty in unused reset-vector code and hardware routines.

Matching reconstruction and text tools with semantic state-machine dispatch alongside original-address symbols. Author reports 1130 matching code regions; this does not certify all assets, readability or whole-game runtime.
Matching US/Japanese reconstruction with semantic actor data and extracted graphics symbols. AI disclosure separates human-reviewed source from largely generated tools/docs.
wxWidgets/ion-engine content editor with tiles, stamps and map workflows. Experimental SNES tile support does not establish finished SNES exporters.
Translation code/art/script and VWF build pipeline using Kosinski compression and 68k assembly.
CHR conversion and map modification with tile deduplication under flips. Inspected optimizer distinguishes flat/blank tiles and calculates flipped CRCs.
VDP1 drawing and memory-performance probes using Yaul. Actual memory benchmark performs width-specific writes and counts operations; no root README does not mean no implementation.
Function-name map, physics/archive/model studies and RNC tools, not distributed decompiled C. Source explicitly distinguishes symbol naming from a rebuilt executable.
Preserved VB6 image-creation application with maintainer fixes. Inspected event code validates paths and dispatches DiscJuggler/Nero operations, unlike a binary-only download.
IP executable loader and PC-I/O bridge with added Maple passthrough. Inspected target command handlers implement network transfer and execution handoff.
Typed field/model/camera code with PsyQ compiler-version annotations and retained address symbols. Matching project, not a finished native PC port.
Electron/CLI installation manager with published plans and optional AI repository interpretation. It orchestrates external ports; it does not itself decompile all listed games.
Electron/Angular audio preparation for mono 8-bit ProTracker/8SVX output. Current changelog describes JavaScript conversion replacing older SoX dependency.
Sonic Arranger format decoding, replay/conversion and newer tracker UI. Paula channel state models period-latched samples; isolated audio synthesis is not a BAKED EMULATION game-port classification.
Native/Python network transfer and development-deployment clients for M4. Inspected C helper calculates AMSDOS header checksum.
RIFF/AMS CPR maker and bank dumper. Source enforces 16 KiB per bank and at most 32 banks, with explicit raw-output and padding options.
On-machine Spectranet module exposes GDB packets after NMI entry. Inspected server implements checksummed packets and TCP port 1667.
Adaptation of CamelForth/80 with Sega PSG/VDP words and keyboard support. Inspected extensions emit hardware port writes.

Inspected batch orchestration, but actual image conversion depends on bundled executables and proprietary menu ZIPs without corresponding implementation source here. Retain as an audit lead rather than promote a wrapper as recovered tooling.
